claim: The Resource Groups Tagging API reference says that the GetResources operation supports all resource types, and the page notes exceptions for IAM users and roles (not supported by GetResources) and for EC2 Auto Scaling groups (an empty response). GetResources returns the tagged or previously tagged resources in the specified Region for the account. Amazon EFS lets you create tags for EFS file systems and access points, and AWS Resource Groups lists AWS::EFS::FileSystem as a resource type for tag-based groups.
note: requests-23 for fr-0100 (verify steps of efs-fsx-t02 and efs-fsx-t03). Rev 3 (fix-23) takes the wording that the rev-2 entail voter said the quotes carry: 'the page notes exceptions' instead of the exhaustive 'names two exceptions', and drops the absence clause 'EFS file systems are not among the named exceptions'. GetResources is Regional, so the verify call must run in each Region where the task created a file system (efs-fsx-t03: us-east-1 and us-west-2). Needs a fresh entail and currency vote.
